name: SPY Opening Range VWAP Pullback
description: Intraday mean-reversion strategy that trades pullbacks to VWAP after opening range breakouts. Enters when price returns to VWAP in the direction of the initial break.
source:
# SPY Opening Range VWAP Pullback
# Intraday mean-reversion strategy
#
# RULES:
# - Opening Range: 9:30am - 9:45am (first 15 minutes)
# - Bullish bias: Price breaks above opening range high
# - Bearish bias: Price breaks below opening range low
# - Entry: After 9:45am, pullback to daily VWAP
#   - LONG if bullish bias + price touches VWAP
#   - SHORT if bearish bias + price touches VWAP
# - Exit: Close all positions at 3:45pm Eastern

# Data source - 5 minute bars for intraday
src = market_data_source(timeframe=5Min)()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# Daily VWAP
daily_vwap = vwap()()

# Opening Range Session (9:30am - 9:45am Eastern)
opening_range = session_window(session=Session(start="09:30", end="09:45", tz="America/New_York"))()

# Opening range high and low (forward-filled after session closes)
or_high = ffill(opening_range.high)
or_low = ffill(opening_range.low)

# Opening range session status
or_active = opening_range.active
or_closed = opening_range.closed

# Determine bias AFTER opening range closes
# Bullish: price broke above OR high
# Bearish: price broke below OR low
broke_above_or = high > or_high
broke_below_or = low < or_low

# Track if we've had a break after OR closed
# Use cumulative max to persist the break signals
after_or = not or_active and or_closed

# Bullish bias: first break above OR high after session closes
is_bullish_break = after_or and broke_above_or
is_bearish_break = after_or and broke_below_or

# Hold the bias using barssince
bars_since_bullish = barssince()(is_bullish_break)
bars_since_bearish = barssince()(is_bearish_break)

# Determine current bias (first break wins for the day)
has_bullish_bias = is_valid(bars_since_bullish)
has_bearish_bias = is_valid(bars_since_bearish) and not has_bullish_bias

# VWAP touch detection
# Price touches VWAP when low <= VWAP <= high
vwap_touch = low <= daily_vwap and daily_vwap <= high

# Entry time filter: after 9:45am
is_after_or = after_or

# Exit time: 3:45pm Eastern
exit_session = session_window(session=Session(start="15:45", end="16:00", tz="America/New_York"))()
is_exit_time = exit_session.active

# Entry signals
# LONG: bullish bias + VWAP touch + after opening range
enter_long = has_bullish_bias and vwap_touch and is_after_or and not is_exit_time

# SHORT: bearish bias + VWAP touch + after opening range  
enter_short = has_bearish_bias and vwap_touch and is_after_or and not is_exit_time

# Hold positions until exit time
held_long = hold_until()(enter=enter_long, exit=is_exit_time)
held_short = hold_until()(enter=enter_short, exit=is_exit_time)

# Entry/Exit zones
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long, short_entry=held_short)

# Position sizing - 100% allocation
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=100 if held_long or held_short else 0)

# Visualization
timeseries_lines(
    title="VWAP and Opening Range",
    category="Indicators",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="VWAP", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="OR High", color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="OR Low", color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(daily_vwap, or_high, or_low)
